_why: The firehose payload contract, written down once and read by BOTH
suites: the bridge that emits these (tests/test_contract.py here)
and the plugin that renders them (Hermes/plugins/samantha_code/
tests/test_contract.py). Before this each side hand-wrote its own
copy of the keys, so a rename on the bridge broke only the
bridge's tests and the plugin stayed green against a shape nothing
sent any more. One representative payload per event kind is
enough — the values are illustrative, the KEYS are the contract.
